title: God Pack Cookies
description: A mod that adds Vanilla Creme Cookies to Minecraft which can be crafted easily.
body:
This mod adds vanilla creme cookies to minecraft that can be crafted with bland cookies and vanilla creme.

Vanilla Creme cookies can be in a wrapper (gives 15 hunger bars) or as a single cookie (only gives 2). A "god pack" (pack of cookies) only requires 5 cookies to craft so you do get more value by crafting the pack.



**JEI IS RECOMMENDED FOR THIS MOD.** Recipes are basic, but can be hard to understand. JEI (Just Enough Items) is recommended.



Textures may be changed or updated and I may add different cookies in the future.
